disambiguation: It is a local bridge exposing specific vault tools via HTTP, not a general-purpose vault management tool.
extras: Local-only deployment model; uses a generated self-signed certificate for HTTPS; includes an optional stdio fallback executable.
problem: External MCP clients need a secure, local way to interact with and manage the files within an Obsidian vault.

requires.name: An MCP client with Streamable HTTP support

summary: A local bridge that connects MCP clients to an Obsidian vault, exposing eight vault tools via Streamable HTTP MCP.
